zen.text: Gideon Jura leads the Zendikari army in its first march on Sea Gate with a shout of "For Zendikar!", but his order to retreat turns into a rout when the army dissolves.

Tazri tells him he led from the front without a plan, so over several days he meets the commanders and builds one that gives every contingent a role, and with Nissa's elementals and Kiora's help Sea Gate is reclaimed.
When Jori En warns that Ulamog is coming, Gideon orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan, and he stands alone before it until the hedron prison pulls Ulamog in.
The victory is short-lived, because Ob Nixilis drowns Gideon in muddy water, and Chandra later finds him held in midair with Jace and Nissa and joins them in defeating the demon.

roe.text: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar and is admitted into Fort Keff in Akoum after dark.
A caged surrakar warns him that the gods are coming, and when a cloud of yellow dust brings the Eldrazi spawn to the gates, Gideon draws his sural, leaps into the fray and saves the fort.
Facing a titan he cannot defeat, Gideon has the surrakar released to lead everyone out along the underground river, then vows to return and planeswalks to Ravnica.

gtc.text: Gideon Jura is brought before Aurelia in the Boros war room, where she has heard he saved a brigade from a Rakdos ambush and tells him he must first fight among the rank and file.
She shows him the contested Ninth and offers him command of a battalion, and because he remembers seeing Zendikar devoured, Gideon decides he is needed here and accepts without becoming Boros.

ori.text: Gideon's origin is the fourth of the five Magic Origins stories, and it shows Kytheon throwing Heliod's spear at Erebos, who redirects it and kills all his irregulars, so that ashamed, he makes his first planeswalk to Bant and becomes Gideon.

On Zendikar he kills an Eldrazi monstrosity with a shard of hedron and holds a canyon pass so survivors from Bala Ged can escape, but Sea Gate falls to the Eldrazi, and he meets Jori En carrying her dead companion Kendrin, who had been on the brink of a leyline discovery.

Concluding that Kendrin's puzzle may be an answer and that he needs another expert, Gideon rides an Eldrazi off the sea wall, planeswalks to Ravnica and collapses on the steps of the Chamber of the Guildpact.
He asks Jace for help, and the two seek out Chandra, who tells them she belongs on Regatha and has made a promise, so Gideon and Jace go on without her.

bfz.text: Gideon appears on a rock where an Eldrazi has landed, lashes it away with his sural, hauls everyone up and reunites with Jori En, then leads the survivors across floating rocks to an encampment.
When the dying Vorik names him Commander-General of the Zendikari, Gideon, who had argued for retaking Sea Gate instead of evacuating, rallies the survivors at the funeral to fight back.
Tazri pledges to fight beside him, and he gathers allies from Drana's army, the roilmages of Noyan Dar and Kiora's merfolk, who together wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi.
Gideon then lures Ulamog into the ring of hedrons while Nissa and Jace activate the network, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.

ogw.text: Gideon is freed from Ob Nixilis by Chandra, and the four planeswalkers swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
Against the titans the Gatewatch chooses a direct attack in which Nissa shapes the leylines into a binding glyph while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush.
Afterward Jace and Gideon resolve to leave Zendikar to gather intelligence, while Nissa stays as its guardian.

kld.text: On Kaladesh Gideon clashes with Chandra and Liliana over how the Gatewatch should treat the Consulate, and he asks over coffee whether it should be taking sides in this local conflict at all.
He tells Chandra the Gatewatch came for her, not to topple the Consulate, and confronts Liliana for killing Consulate forces, though she argues that death is a tool.

Gideon then assigns roles for the assault on the Aether Hub and persuades Chandra to lead the renegades by example, and when Chandra proposes to be the disruptor herself, he relents and decides she is not going alone.
He shields Chandra with his golden glow as she builds a star of flame for the impact, and later he invites Ajani to join the Gatewatch.

aer.text: Gideon wonders how the consuls can be so blind to Tezzeret's manipulations, while the Gatewatch plans with the renegades to take over the Aether Hub.
Gideon destroys a Gearhulk with his indestructible body, then he and Chandra destroy the planar bridge from inside a thopter, shielding her from the fireblast, though Tezzeret escapes.
Afterward Gideon inducts Ajani into the Gatewatch.

akh.text: Gideon Jura and the Gatewatch arrive on Amonkhet to find and stop Bolas, and they fight undead and sand wurms, until a towering jackal-headed figure saves the group.
Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, and once the group enters the city he meets the god Oketra, who names him Kytheon Iora.

Despite Chandra's objections he joins the Trials as Oketra's Champion, and at the trial before Bontu he furiously denounces the slaughter and dives across to confront her, until she commands him to leave her temple.

Having realized the anointed are the remnants of fallen initiates, he tears the cartouche from his neck and resolves to strike down Bolas, but Bolas defeats the Gatewatch and Gideon, severely wounded, loses his sural and planeswalks away.

dom.text: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, where he lost his sural and his faith in himself, and after Nissa and Chandra leave he decides to stay and work with Liliana.
Liliana confesses that the lich leading the Cabal is her brother Josu, whom she made undead as a girl, and Gideon agrees to help lay him to rest.
Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold, and he infiltrates the Stronghold and finds it in the fourth treasury vault.
Gideon and Liliana defeat Belzenlok with the Blackblade, but Bolas appears to claim Liliana, and Gideon leaves Dominaria to follow her trail.

war.text: Gideon Jura leads the resistance on Ravnica, telling the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people, and he vows to take back the world with the Blackblade.
He kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade, then rides Rakdos against Bolas, but the blade shatters against the dragon, who had enchanted it.
When Liliana betrays Bolas and he cancels her demonic pact, Gideon takes the contract upon himself and dies in her place.

jmp.text: Gideon falls from his pegasus over Ravnica, still holding the Blackblade, when Oketra's shot pierces the beast.

clu.text: Gideon asks a pegasus whether it would give its life to save the world.

j25.text: Gideon flies to strike a god with his dark sword as Ravnica watches, and he rallies those who still stand after Sea Gate falls.
